title: Bimodal Thickness Initialization with Relaxed Bounds for Dual-Stopband Filter
scientific_hypothesis: A bimodal thickness distribution spanning 20-60 nm and 150-300 nm will sample both thin-film interference orders and thicker propagation phases, improving optimizer convergence and recovering the iteration_02 performance level of 0.9275 target score.
design_principle: Feedback directive specifies bimodal reinitialization to restore valid_candidate throughput above 10% of population while relaxing thickness bounds by +5 nm on both sides to address numerical convergence failures.
proposed_topology: 36-layer alternating stack: Air | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Fused Silica substrate
manufacturing_considerations: individual layer thickness 15-355 nm (relaxed from 20-350 nm by +5 nm)
Ta2O5/SiO2 material pair compatible with plasma ion-assisted deposition
theory_basis: Quarter-wave stack optimization principle from evidence showing smoothed spectral characteristics require varying optical thickness away from quarter-wavelength values
Multi-wavelength high-reflectance designs benefit from non-quarter-wave optical thicknesses optimized via needle technique
expected_advantages: Relaxed bounds restore valid candidate throughput above 10%
Bimodal initialization samples diverse interference orders
May recover iteration_02 performance level of 0.9275
known_risks: Extreme bimodal distribution may create numerical instability
Score regression may continue if underlying optimization landscape changed
execution_request_english: Optimize a 36-layer alternating Ta2O5/SiO2 dielectric filter on fused silica substrate at 0 degree incidence with unpolarized light. Layer sequence: Ta2O5, SiO2, Ta2O5, SiO2, Ta2O5, SiO2, Ta2O5, SiO2, Ta2O5, SiO2, Ta2O5, SiO2, Ta2O5, SiO2, Ta2O5, SiO2, Ta2O5, SiO2, Ta2O5, SiO2, Ta2O5, SiO2, Ta2O5, SiO2, Ta2O5, SiO2, Ta2O5, SiO2, Ta2O5, SiO2, Ta2O5, SiO2, Ta2O5, SiO2, Ta2O5, SiO2 (18 Ta2O5 layers, 18 SiO2 layers). All layer thicknesses bounded between 15 nm and 355 nm. Initialize optimization population with bimodal distribution: 50% of layers sampled from 20-60 nm range, 50% from 150-300 nm range. Optimize to maximize average transmittance in 420-700 nm passband while minimizing average transmittance in 355-365 nm stopband, 1030-1080 nm stopband, and at 355 nm single wavelength. Use gradient-based thickness optimizer with step-size constraints. Report best target score, valid candidate count, tightest margin, and thickness arrays for all candidates. Canonical user controls: incidence angles 0 degrees. polarization unpolarized. wavelength intervals 355-355 nm, 355-365 nm, 420-700 nm, 1030-1080 nm. soft objectives: high average transmittance in 420-700 nm; low average transmittance at 355 nm; low average transmittance in 355-365 nm; low average transmittance in 1030-1080 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: high transmittance at 355 nm; high transmittance in 355-365 nm; high transmittance in 1030-1080 nm; high loss in 420-700 nm. manufacturing constraints: maximum 36 layers; layer thickness range 20-350 nm.
revision_reason: Following feedback directive to reinitialize with bimodal thickness distribution and relax bounds by +5 nm on both sides to restore valid_candidate throughput above 10% of population after score regression from 0.9275 to 0.6263.
